topics.name: Plasmid cloning and bacterial transformation
topics.description: Building plasmids by restriction-ligation, Gibson, Golden Gate or similar assembly, transforming E. coli, and screening colonies for the intended construct.

topics.name: PCR and qPCR amplification
topics.description: End-point PCR, genotyping PCR, RT-qPCR and digital PCR: amplification failure, non-specific products, and abnormal quantification curves.

topics.name: Western blot and protein detection
topics.description: SDS-PAGE, membrane transfer and immunoblot detection of proteins from lysates or pull-downs: missing, weak, unexpected or smeared bands and high background.

topics.name: Recombinant protein expression and purification
topics.description: Expressing recombinant proteins in bacteria, insect or mammalian cells and purifying them by affinity, ion-exchange or size-exclusion chromatography: low yield, insolubility, degradation, impurity.

topics.name: CRISPR genome editing
topics.description: Cas9, base- or prime-editing of cultured cells or organisms, including guide delivery, knock-in by homology-directed repair, and genotyping of edited clones.

topics.name: Transfection and viral transduction
topics.description: Delivering nucleic acids to cells by lipid transfection, electroporation or nucleofection, and producing and using lentiviral, retroviral or AAV vectors.

topics.name: Immunofluorescence staining
topics.description: Antibody-based fluorescent staining of fixed cells, tissue sections or whole mounts and its imaging: absent or weak signal, high background, non-specific staining.

topics.name: Sequencing library preparation
topics.description: Preparing libraries for RNA-seq, single-cell sequencing, ATAC-seq, CUT&Tag, CUT&RUN or ChIP-seq, including tagmentation, amplification and library quality control.
